plugins.name: game-ideation
plugins.description: A collection of AI agent skills for game ideation and early development workflows, based on the Daniel Dumont workshop methodology (Making Games Magazin 2010/2011). The plugin bundles the `init-game-docs` foundation skill (scaffolds the Dumont document structure and hosts shared workshop references) and stage-specific skills like `write-game-idea` that co-develop each design document with the user.
